data: NVIDIA's revenue grew from $26.97 billion in fiscal 2023 (the year ended January 29, 2023) to $130.50 billion in fiscal 2025 (the year ended January 26, 2025). That is an increase of about $103.5 billion, or roughly 384%, meaning fiscal 2025 revenue was nearly 4.8 times the fiscal 2023 level. Most of the growth came from the Data Center segment, driven by demand for AI accelerators. In between, fiscal 2024 revenue was $60.92 billion, up about 126% from fiscal 2023, and fiscal 2025 then rose about 114% from fiscal 2024.
